column1: # Derived from the human-rated concreteness norms of Brysbaert, Warriner &
# Kuperman (2014), "Concreteness ratings for 40 thousand generally known
# English word lemmas", Behavior Research Methods 46, 904-911.
# Transform: abstractness = round((5 - Conc.M) / 4 * 100). Single words only;
# words known to fewer than 85% of raters are excluded.
# Curated project-specific additions belong in abstractness_extra_en.tsv
# (same format, one "word<TAB>grade" per line); they override this file.
